entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Order number is VF78-9910.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Just to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Look, I don't have time for a survey. I just don't want it. The color is wrong. It's still in the box unopened. Can I return it, yes or no?
Yes, absolutely. No problem at all. Let me just pull up that order... VF78-9910. Okay, I see you purchased the Aero Road Helmet, delivered about two months ago.
That's right. So, are we done here? Can you send me the label?

We certainly are. You're well within our 90-day return window. Getting the right gear is critical for both performance and safety, so we want to make sure you're happy with your choice. I'm processing the return label for you right now.
Good. Send it to my email.

It's on its way. Also, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee and added a 20% discount code to that email for your next purchase. Perhaps you can find another helmet in a color you prefer.
Oh. Okay, that's actually useful. Thanks.
You're very welcome. You should see that email in the next couple of minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
